title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani secretly consults Mathangi about divorcing Anbu, who advises hiding her pregnancy from him. Meanwhile, Maha forces a hesitant Vennila to meet a prospective groom.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman cleverly gets Ilamathi to perform the Varalakshmi Pooja as a couple, leaving her delighted. Leelavathi buys Kumaresan's house and hastily registers it in her name.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Sudar stands by Vetri and begs Abinaya to bring him inside. Shanmugam lets Vetri stay outside with conditions, while an angry Karna vents to Divakar.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Poongodi is confused by Thenmozhi's tears as Manjamalai takes her away. Meanwhile, Azhagar and Pennycuick seek to free Mayandi and Meenatchi after Manjamalai files a complaint.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Malar panics when Ragavan learns of her bride visit with Bagyaraj, but thanks him for his support. Shruthi rejoices as Karthi's wedding plans hit a major roadblock.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Sudar expresses her concern to Thangamayil about Kumar's reluctant acceptance of her. Meanwhile, Senthil and Kathir launch a fierce attack on Kumar for troubling Arasi.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nadesan stops Kasturi from creating trouble as Cheran and Chandayatha exchange rings happily, and their marriage date is fixed. Their joyful moment leaves Karthika envious.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Vijaya takes steps to find an alliance for Manoj, but the family opposes her move until Rohini's divorce is settled. Later, Meena and Shruthi visit Rohini and offer their support.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Tamizhselvi warns Aishwarya to raise Azhagar while ensuring he recognizes her as his mother. Eshwari sets a high ceremony budget to burden Tamizhselvi with expenses.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Kasturi and Karthik struggle through a fan-less night, taking turns with a hand fan. Saranya is pleased when Kasturi wakes early and helps with the household chores.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Murugan and Indhira visit the temple and offer prayers, while Indhira enjoys the blessed food. Later, Abhi clashes with Indhira after she gets served first at the hotel.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: A Fun Court Task
description: Contestants clash in an intense court task featuring fiery debates, hilarious floor arguments, and a special witness appearance. Who will get the Red and Green stars today?
